controls.statement: Resilience, dependency-failure, failover, rollback, roll-forward, and recovery results.
controls.primary_reason: The resilience and recovery result classes form a finite manifest with exact release and scenario bindings.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains resilience, dependency-failure, failover, rollback, roll-forward, and recovery results for every applicable class.

controls.statement: Security scan, code review, threat-validation, and penetration-test results.
controls.primary_reason: Security scan, review, threat-validation, and penetration-test results are explicit package artifacts with tool, scope, date, and release bindings.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains current security-scan, code-review, threat-validation, and penetration-test results for each applicable class.

controls.statement: SBOM, license report, build provenance, artifact signatures, and attestation evidence.
controls.primary_reason: SBOM, license report, provenance, signatures, and attestations have exact digests and cryptographic or referential integrity checks.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains a verified SBOM, license report, build provenance, artifact signatures, and attestation evidence bound to the artifact digest.

controls.statement: Infrastructure, network, DNS, certificate, secrets, and production-configuration review.
controls.primary_reason: The six named review areas are explicit required package records with environment and configuration bindings.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains current infrastructure, network, DNS, certificate, secrets, and production-configuration review records.

controls.statement: Backup, restoration, disaster-recovery, and continuity evidence.
controls.primary_reason: Backup, restoration, disaster-recovery, and continuity evidence are finite package entries whose scenario and execution bindings can be validated.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains current backup, restoration, disaster-recovery, and continuity evidence for every applicable plan.

controls.statement: Incident-response, on-call, alerting, runbook, and communications drill evidence.
controls.primary_reason: The named operational drill evidence classes are finite required package entries with dates, participants, and release-context references.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains incident-response, on-call, alerting, runbook, and communications drill evidence.

controls.statement: Monitoring, dashboard, synthetic-check, logging, audit, and telemetry review.
controls.primary_reason: Monitoring and telemetry review types are explicit package entries whose source and review bindings can be checked.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains monitoring, dashboard, synthetic-check, logging, audit, and telemetry review records.

controls.statement: Third-party risk, contract, subprocessor, and continuity review.
controls.primary_reason: Third-party risk, contract, subprocessor, and continuity review records are finite package artifacts tied to the supplier inventory.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains current third-party risk, contract, subprocessor, and continuity review records for every applicable supplier.

controls.statement: Open defect, risk, and exception registers.
controls.primary_reason: Open defect, risk, and exception registers are explicit package artifacts with immutable versions.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains current open-defect, risk, and exception registers.

controls.statement: Every exception's owner, impact, compensating control, monitoring, remediation plan, and expiry.
controls.primary_reason: Exception identifiers can be joined to a fixed required field set, making omissions mechanically decidable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every exception in the final package records owner, impact, compensating control, monitoring, remediation plan, and expiry.

controls.statement: Deployment, rollback or roll-forward, and post-deployment validation plans.
controls.primary_reason: Deployment, recovery-path, and post-deployment validation plans are explicit release-bound package artifacts.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains deployment, rollback or roll-forward, and post-deployment validation plans bound to the release.

controls.statement: Required approvals, sign-offs, and final decision rationale.
controls.primary_reason: An approval matrix and signed decision record allow required approvals, sign-offs, and rationale presence to be checked exactly.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The final evidence package contains every required authenticated approval and sign-off plus the final decision rationale.

controls.statement: Review the corpus at least annually and after major standards revisions.
controls.primary_reason: The annual maximum interval and authoritative major-standards revision events allow exact review-deadline checks.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: The corpus has an authenticated review no more than one year old.
Every recorded major revision of a tracked standard links to a later corpus review.

controls.statement: Review it when entering a new jurisdiction, sector, user population, deployment model, or contractual regime.
controls.primary_reason: Entry events for jurisdictions, sectors, user populations, deployment models, and contractual regimes can be matched to later corpus review records.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every recorded entry into a new jurisdiction, sector, user population, deployment model, or contractual regime links to a later corpus review.

controls.statement: Track authoritative standards and mark published, amended, withdrawn, superseded, and draft status accurately.
controls.primary_reason: Issuing-body registries provide authoritative status values that can be compared with every tracked standards record.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every tracked standard's published, amended, withdrawn, superseded, or draft status matches its issuing body's current record.

controls.statement: Do not replace current published baselines with drafts unless a documented transition decision requires early adoption.
controls.primary_reason: Baseline and draft statuses plus transition-decision records make unauthorized draft replacement mechanically detectable.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: No current published baseline is replaced by a draft unless a prior authenticated transition decision explicitly authorizes early adoption.

controls.statement: Preserve historical corpus versions and the exact version used for each release or audit.
controls.primary_reason: Immutable corpus versions and release or audit references can prove historical preservation and exact-version binding.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every historical corpus version remains retrievable by digest, and every release or audit references exactly one such version.

controls.statement: Record every added, changed, moved, or retired control with rationale and owner.
controls.primary_reason: Corpus diffs enumerate added, changed, moved, and retired controls, allowing exact changelog coverage and required fields.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every control change detected between corpus versions has a changelog entry with action, rationale, and owner.

controls.statement: Validate all Markdown links, headings, checklist syntax, front matter, encoding, and relative paths automatically.
controls.primary_reason: Markdown links, headings, checklist tokens, front matter, encoding, and relative paths have exact parsers and bounded repository targets.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every corpus Markdown file passes the versioned link, heading, checklist-syntax, front-matter, encoding, and relative-path validators.
